description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface, including methods for formatting and appending log messages, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, with capabilities to format and display log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and displays it in the LogView, also passing it to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
